table_title: List the 24 member universities of the Russell Group (UK-based research-intensive university association founded 1994) with University name, Nation (constituent country of the UK), Year of Joining (year admitted to Russell Group — 1994 for the founding 17 members; 1998 for Cardiff + King's College; 2006 for Queen's Belfast; 2012 for Durham + Exeter + Queen Mary + York), Total Students (2021/22), and Total Academic Staff (2022/23). Universe per cycle-1 audit's pivot from initially-proposed Founding-Year + City schema (which was NOT master-supported — would have required 24 per-university Wikipedia pages + reopened ambiguous founding-date issues) to master-supported schema (Nation + Year of Joining + Total Students + Total Academic Staff — all directly extractable from Wikipedia Russell Group master article's 24-row member table). Per cycle-1 audit SUGGESTIONs: (a) 'London School of Economics' NOT 'London School of Economics and Political Science' per master-table label; (b) 'N. Ire.' kept verbatim per master (NOT expanded to 'Northern Ireland').
db_analog: SELECT university_name, nation, year_of_joining_russell_group, total_students_2021_22, total_academic_staff_2022_23 FROM wiki_russell_group_members_table ORDER BY university_name ASC
